rubrics.justification: Generally describes a good-quality expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona, but introduces uncertainty between 3AA/4AA and mentions features like patchy TE/debris that may not be clearly supported from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors well with prognosis, though diagnosis and some cycle-specific nuances are not deeply explored.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, linking embryo quality and patient age to prognosis appropriately; minor issues include some hedging about morphology and slightly variable probability framing.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and cautious interpretation of morphology, though a few speculative protocol suggestions and comments on endometrial thickness are less tightly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support adherence, lifestyle optimization, and future cycle review, but some recommendations remain somewhat generic rather than highly case-specific.
